Your nickname and optional photo are stored on this device and are not sent with assessments. When you explicitly connect a nearby Conversation, your nickname is shared with that peer; the photo is not shared. Do not use patient information here.

Offline Whisper requires a verified local model. If it is missing, explicitly prepare it from Settings using an internet connection. This page does not download models. The alternative system speech provider depends on the device. Typed input remains available.

One Triage helps you describe symptoms and request an AI assessment. Whisper processes audio on this device; the optional Android speech service may use the internet. Only the original text you review and approve is sent to OpenAI. AI can be wrong and is not an emergency service. For immediate danger, contact local emergency services.
The speaker button reads text using an installed offline system voice. Voice availability depends on the selected language and device. No voice model is downloaded automatically.
